gen-dafont-dogica-fs-bespoke-slab: Dogica stretches its heavy, wide-tracked letters out with lowercase that climbs nearly to the capitals, every curve left visibly open at its end. Bespoke Slab, a classic serif, settles underneath with tall, grounded forms.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab is grounded and refined, a text serif whose tall lowercase barely varies in stroke weight. Early GameBoy sits above it with spread-out letters and a gentle thick-thin shift, so the two feel playful against studious.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab reads grounded and refined, its serif lowercase standing tall with very little stroke variation. And Edo SZ, drawn like a marker with one constant line, gives the heading a cast-iron stature to push against.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-fs-trench-slab: Trench Slab is a dignified text serif whose lowercase rises almost to the height of its capitals. Trench Slab against Edo SZ's single-tip, constant-width simplicity makes a pair with real weight and a firm, cast-iron look.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-fs-bespoke-s: Eight Bit Dragon strides along with widely separated, towering lowercase letters. Bespoke Slab, a text serif with equally tall bodies, takes over below with grounded, refined strokes that look steadier next to the heading's subtle modulation.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-fs-bespoke-sl: Electroharmonix breaks every word into single, open-gapped letters with generous curves in each round character. Bespoke Slab, a text serif with tall lowercase, can be sized up a notch to hold its own beneath that striking heading.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-fs-erode: Electroharmonix splits each word into separate letters, with open-handed curves and a sizable x-height that reads well on screen. Erode, a text serif with sturdy hairlines and a gentle ebb of stroke weight, brings editorial dignity beneath it.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-fs-trench-sla: Trench Slab, a classic serif with almost no gap between x-height and capitals, feels dignified and refined, and it keeps a dense, upright texture across paragraphs. Electroharmonix scatters its letters above, striking and loud.
gen-dafont-eraser-fs-bespoke-serif: Eraser's bold letters never swell or thin, as if one steady pen pressure carried from first letter to last. Bespoke Serif, a text serif with thin strokes about half its thick ones, would look louder if Eraser were made small.
gen-dafont-eraser-fs-erode: Understated but commanding, Eraser draws bold letters with no thick or thin strokes anywhere. And Erode, a serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, adds a gentle ebb and flow of weight beneath.
